subject: Avalon Health - Request for executive approval: 28% Hosted API discount

From: Sana Rao <sana.rao@avalonhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pricing ask and timeline - Avalon Health Hosted API

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the engineering team was impressed with the inference benchmarks. Procurement is moving faster than expected and we need a final pricing position from Redwood by the end of the month to include in our board packet.

Quick summary of where we landed internally:
- Expected steady-state usage: ~1.2B tokens/month (text generation + embeddings) after a 3-month ramp.
- Multi-region read access required (US + EU), potential later expansion to APAC.
- Avalon is pushing for a >25% discount to meet internal TCO targets; their procurement asks specifically call out 28%.

We understand this is outside standard published host pricing. We’d like to know if Redwood can support a 28% concession in exchange for a 36-month commitment, annual prepay, and a joint PR/reference agreement.

Attached is a simple traffic forecast template to make the numbers concrete (Avalon_MA_Pipeline_Template.xlsx).

We’re on a tight timeline — can you confirm whether you can escalate for executive approval? If so, we need any signed terms or pricing memo by 2027-04-30.

Best,
Sana Rao
Head of Platform Partnerships
Avalon Health

Ben / Marcus — looping you in. Avalon (prospect-to-enterprise conversion) is asking for a 28% off list on Hosted API usage. Quick context below and rationale for asking senior sign-off:

Why they matter
- Target customer in payer-provider space; strong reference potential and long-term strategic fit for multi-region workloads.
- Forecasted steady-state spend looks material: ~1.2B tokens/month -> estimated $180k/month at current list before discounts (numbers in the attached forecast).

Commercial ask
- 28% off hosted API usage pricing for a 36-month committed term, with annual prepay and a two-stage ramp (3 months).
- We get: multi-year committed revenue, reference, joint case study, and early access to Avalon’s internal feature requests (priority bug fixes).

Risk mitigations I propose
- Contract will include a minimum committed spend for year 1 and year 2.
- Performance SLA: start with hosted offering; if they move to Dedicated later, pricing uplift negotiated then.
- Legal redlines limited to data residency & SOC2 standard clauses; see attached redline (contract_redline_v2.pdf).

Ask
- Can we get exec authorization for a 28% discount (i.e. >20% threshold) subject to Finance/Legal confirmation? Avalon needs a signed commercial memo by 2027-04-30 to keep procurement momentum.

I’ve added a short one-pager below with the key terms for quick review. If you’re comfortable, can Ben sign off or direct Karthik to approve? I can draft the DocuSign envelope once we have the green light.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing ask and timeline - Avalon Health Hosted API — request for exec approval (28%)

Thanks for the context, Mina. I agree Avalon is strategically interesting and the revenue profile is attractive, but 28% is above our usual concession band for hosted usage. A few notes from my side:

1) Requirement for strict minimum committed spend per year is non-negotiable if we move this deep; need clarity on the exact thresholds.
2) I want Finance to validate modeled unit economics on their forecast (the attached spreadsheet looks optimistic). Marcus, can you run the numbers and confirm net margin impact at 28% with the proposed ramp & prepay?
3) If Finance/legal are comfortable, I’d be willing to consider approval up to 24% at the VP level. Anything north of that should come from Karthik as a senior exec exception.

Please iterate the commercial memo with the minimums called out. If they truly commit to the 36 months and annual prepay, that moves the needle for sure.

-Ben

Ben / team,

I reviewed the forecast, risk mitigations and the proposed contractual limits. Given the strategic upside (multi-region reference, large committed volume, and potential dedicated expansion) I approve the 28% hosted API usage concession as an executive exception with the following conditions:

1) Term & payment: Minimum 24-month firm commitment (out of the requested 36) with annual prepayment for both years 1 and 2. Year 3 optional and subject to review.
2) Minimums: The contract must specify a floor committed spend of $1.5M ARR from Avalon across years 1-2 combined.
3) Ramp language: 3-month ramp to steady-state usage; if usage lags the forecast by >40% at month 6, pricing reverts to 15% discount until ramp criteria are met.
4) Legal: No unusual indemnities; standard SOC2/data residency confirmations only. Legal to deliver final signoff on redline within 48 hours of DocuSign send.
5) Sales Ops: Update HubSpot deal DL-2027-0457 with the concession and mark the approver field as "Karthik Iyer — Exec Exception Approved 2027-04-27".

I’ve attached a short exec approval memo for records (exec_approval_memo_20270427.pdf). Finance, Marcus — please confirm you’re good with the margin impact under those conditions ASAP.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
